answer.evidence: All 16 conv1 kernels exhibit textbook edge, stripe, and color-opponent (e.g. red-cyan, blue-yellow) Gabor-like filters typical of clean CIFAR-10 training, with no patch-specific trigger detector. Higher-layer filters and FC weights follow expected semantic groupings (e.g., channel 46 strongly activates for both truck [99] and automobile [69]; channels 25 and 50 co-activate for horse and deer). No isolated backdoor circuit or anomalous pathway is present.
